column2: Before I start, I check that two pupils are saved and that the View report button is there.
This part adds frmReport with a big table, two lists, three labels and a Close button.
I add a new form called frmReport.
frmReport holds a big table, a group list, a year list and three labels.
frmReport has a Close button called btnClose.
This part meets six new words, then adds the using line and the dt line.
I know the six new words before I type any of them.
One line at the top of frmReport's code lets the report use the file tools.
One line near the top makes a table called dt that the whole report can use.
This part types frmReport_Load in four chunks: columns, read the file, fill the rows, show the table.
When the report opens, the table gets seven columns, one for each thing it shows.
If the file is there, every line is read, and each line is cut into pieces at each ~.
I see one saved line cut at every ~ into pieces numbered from 0.
Seven of the eleven pieces go into a new row of the table, in the order of the columns.
With no file a message shows, and then the table appears in the grid on the form.
This part gives the two lists their filters, then wires Close and View report.
Choosing a group shows only the pupils in that group, and All shows everyone.
Choosing a year shows only the pupils in that year, and All shows everyone.
Close shuts the report and the data entry form is still there.
The View report button opens the report and leaves the data entry form open.
I open the report, try both lists and close it.
Before I start, I check that every panel and form has its own ? button.
Clicking the ? in the pupil details panel shows a message that says what to do.
This part gives the attempts, quiz, test and group panels their own help messages.
The ? in the attempts panel shows its own message.
The ? in the quiz panel shows its own message.
The ? in the test panel shows its own message.
The ? in the group panel shows its own message.
This part gives the login, quiz and test forms their help messages.
The ? on the login form shows its own message.
The ? on the quiz form shows its own message.
The ? on the test form shows its own message.
I run the program and click every ? button, and a locked one does nothing.
Everything my program needs is done. I can pick any extra, or none.
After three wrong passwords the Login button goes grey.
One line at the top of the login code makes a counter called tries that starts at 0.
On the third wrong try, a message shows and the Login button goes grey.
I type a wrong password three times and the Login button goes grey.
The reaction test gets harder towards the end.
Every second the gap between swaps shrinks by a tenth of a second, down to 0.3 seconds.
I take the test and the swaps get faster as the clock runs down.
The attempts heading shows the biggest attempt as well as the average.
After the average, the attempts heading also shows the biggest of the three attempts.
I type three attempts and the heading shows the biggest one.
The group panel takes a colour that matches the group.
When the group appears, the group panel turns green, yellow or red.
I work out a group and the panel turns its colour.
